headline: School Committee to vote on PreSchool Handbook and accept grants including $998,031 IDEA-Part B and $639,855 Title I Part A funding.
summary: The meeting covers approval of the PreSchool Handbook and acceptance of several FY 27 federal and state grants. It also includes a gift of $400.00 for the Robert Natti Story Corner and routine consent agenda items.
items: Acceptance of $400.00 gift from Susanne Natti for the Robert Natti Story Corner, to be split among four elementary schools
Acceptance of O'Maley Middle School Science Center FY 27 FC2518 MA FairShare Earmark Grant of $60,000
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0240-IDEA-Part B (Federal/ENT) Grant of $998,031
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0262-IDEA-Part C (Federal/ENT) Grant of $28,774
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0305-Title I Part A (Federal/ENT) Grant of $639,855
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0140-Title II Part A (Federal/ENT) Grant of $89,250
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0180-Title III Part A (Federal/ENT) Grant of $45,674
Acceptance of FY 27 FC0309-Title IV Part A (Federal/ENT) Grant of $49,235
